text.name: Sword of the Gods
text.description:
{Sword of the Gods}

Increases the hero's Attack and Defense by 3. All friendly targets do +25% damage.
text.event: I wonder why the Sword of the Gods is lying in the middle of the field? You turned your gaze to the sky, thinking maybe this legendary weapon was a gift from heaven. ''If so, why did they choose me?'' – you thought, picking up the blade.
